title: Siege and Storm
author: Leigh Bardugo
summary: The second Grisha book follows a young woman with a rare power who is hunted by enemies. A charming privateer offers her an alliance at sea, and she must decide how much of her own strength she is willing to claim.
readIf: you liked Shadow and Bone and want a faster, more dangerous sequel with a new charismatic ally.
skipIf: you have not read the first book, or you are tired of love triangles.

pairings.reason: Set in the same world, with sharper plotting and a crew of schemers.
Another young-adult fantasy with a rebel heroine and a ruthless empire.
A heroine with an unexpected power, courted by dangerous people on opposing sides.
